why: No source confirms designated RV sites or current overnight camping, checked 2026-11-05. (1) City of Clyde site (clydekansas.org, Community Services page in the Wayback captures of 2016-02, 2024-03 and 2026-05; the live domain refuses connections) describes only 'two parks with playground equipment', a pool, ball field, tennis, pickleball and basketball, and never mentions camping. (2) Cloud County Tourism's Stay page lists Rock Island RV Park as Clyde's only RV option and omits the city park. (3) Google Maps 'Clyde City Park' (196 Perrier St, 39.59485,-97.40408) is a 'Park' with no phone, 4.4 from 11 reviews; the 5 visible (1-5 yrs) are about the playground, basketball court, bathrooms and the demolition derby, none about camping, and the limited view hid the other 6. (4) The only camping claims are aggregators repeating Ultimate Campgrounds data from 'November 2016' (CampgroundTour: '2 sites', '6 electric', $0, no toilets; AllStays: '6 sites ... Tents'), which contradict each other. RV Life does not list it. Esri imagery (2026-11-05, 160 m frame) shows an ordinary town park with no visible RV pads or pedestals.
name: Clyde City Park
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-05: Esri World Imagery at 39.5950,-97.4045 (160 m half-width, rendered): town park with pool, tennis and basketball courts, playground and a ball field, plus a gravel drive on the west side. No water anywhere in the frame.
rvlife: not listed (RV Life Algolia, 5 km around the pin, 2026-11-05: only Rock Island RV Park 263354)
flags: duplicate check: different place from 14548 Rock Island RV Park. Google's Clyde City Park point (39.59485,-97.40408, 196 Perrier St) is 0.49 km WNW of 14548's pin (39.5929,-97.399, 401 Campbell Ave), and the town park has its own pool, courts and ball field. No other DB entry within 25 km except Airport Park, Concordia (2210, 22 km).

possible city RV hookups: CampgroundTour (Ultimate Campgrounds data, 'Data sourced November 2016') lists 6 electric sites at $0 with shared water. If AWH knows of, or the city confirms, overnight camping (City Hall 785-446-3300), this could be re-opened. Nothing dated after 2016 supports it.
AllStays listing 45864 rendered placeholder data on 2026-11-05 (a 555 phone number, 7,069 ft elevation), so it was disregarded.

clydekansas.org refused connections on 2026-11-05 (ECONNREFUSED 216.40.47.17:443); its last Wayback capture is 2026-05-12, so the city site may be down only temporarily. clydekansas.com is a parked domain.
No structured facts confirmed from an authoritative source (hookups, site count, fee, season, booking all unknown).
